incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired :rotating_light: INC-4521 — eval-gate 'output-drift' threshold tripped for route(s) /v1/chat.generate. Severity: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-4521

pagerduty: Automatic incident created. Trigger: eval_gate/output_drift. Failure rate: 12% across sampled requests (30m). Affected model: rdlw-3-quantized@v4. Affected tenants: multiple, rollback candidate: rdlw-3-legacy

Sam: ack — I'm looking. @sre-oncall please confirm who takes this.

Lina: looking at recent evals, gate fails spiked starting 2034499800. 30m window: 127 gate trips, concentrated on safety & hallucination prompts. Attached quick dump below.

```
window: 30m
gate_fail_rate: 0.12
routes: /v1/chat.generate, /v1/complete
failing_prompts: [safety_roleplay, legal_advice_edgecases]
model_variant: rdlw-3-quantized@v4
```

Jordan: oncall here — acked. Confirming P1 because customer-facing regressions coming through Support. What's the mitigation plan?

Alex: Support queue shows tickets: #7892, #7901 from enterprise tenants; a few of them attached example outputs (nonsensical or unsafe). Latency normal. No increased 5xx.

Emily: I see a recent automated job that pushed a new quant-profile to dedicated pools at 2034499700. No other infra churn. Suggest reverting quant-profile or routing traffic to legacy profile.

Sam: mitigation proposal: 1) pin route to rdlw-3-legacy for affected tenants (soft fallback) 2) disable automated eval-gate paging while we triage to avoid pager noise 3) roll back quant-profile on pool-ded-01 if correlation holds.

Jordan: I'll apply routing override for high-traffic tenants and create a rollback ticket for pool-ded-01. Applying routing now (will update).

Lina: routing override applied to tenant 'acme-inc' and 'zephyr' -> traffic routed to rdlw-3-legacy. Confirming reduced fail rate for those tenants after reroute (observed within 2m): gate_fail_rate -> 0.02 for acme-inc.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4521 acknowledged by Jordan at 2034500030

Alex: Support update drafted and posted: "We're investigating output quality regressions; traffic for affected customers has been routed to a verified model variant while we triage. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA."

Sam: started rollback job for quant-profile on pool-ded-01 (ticket INF-251). Rolling restart of 12 workers in progress. ETA ~10m.

Emily: logs after restart show model serving with legacy kernels; preliminary eval samples show pass rate improving.

Jordan: marking incident as Mitigated (customers routed to legacy, rollback started). Still P1 until rollback completes and global metrics stabilize. Will keep pages suppressed for non-critical noise.

Lina: creating timeline + collecting eval artifacts for postmortem. Noting that eval gate threshold was very sensitive to small logits drift after quant change — will add guard in model onboarding runbook.

Jordan: handing off to Sam for overnight follow-up at 2034500500 — Sam, please monitor until rollback finished and then transition to postmortem.

Sam: ack, taking handoff. I'll follow up with a status update in 30m and draft RCA skeleton.

Jordan: closing PD alert to prevent further escalation; will reopen if regressions reappear.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4521 status changed to 'resolved' (manual close by Jordan) at 2034500545

Emily: quick note — metrics to track post-incident: gate_fail_rate (1h/6h), customer tickets reopened, model_version_rollouts in last 24h.

Sam: thanks all. Good job on fast mitigation. Postmortem owners: Lina (traces/evals), Emily (metric dashboards), Jordan & Sam (timeline + RCA).
